notes: §1985:XVI.3.3.4 SRL2.2: a SORT in an independent segment may name input or output procedures 'Wholly within the same independent segment as that SORT statement' (else totally non-independent). SortBinder.CheckSegmentation asks Segmentation.CheckProcedures of each procedure range at COBOL-85 (RulesInForce); RangeAllowed admits all-fixed or one independent segment equal to the statement's, COBOL6877. Probes (SORT in 60): input 60 THRU 10 refused; output 70, paragraph in 70, input 50 and a reversed-order THRU spanning 70 refused; input 60 with output 10, and 49 with 0, accepted and sorted A,B; witness refused; --std 2002: COBOL0902.

next.reason: 1985: "Wholly within the same independent segment as that SORT statement."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the Segmentation feature; no candidate addresses independent segments or where SORT procedures may be placed.". The rule belongs to the Segmentation module. No 2023 clause covers that feature, and no candidate restricts SORT input/output procedures to a segment, so the requirement is dropped.
